items.statement: Phase 1 capex of INR40 cr for TOPcon line; 50% committed; construction complete by June, machinery by July, commercial production from October 2025
items.quote: In terms of the spending, the total capex was considered at INR40 crores. Out of that, around 50% of the capex has been committed.

items.statement: Phase 2 capex to be reviewed after October; funding via term loan and internal accruals
items.quote: For the second phase, after October we will review the situation. Some of the funding will be raised through the term loan and some from the internal accrual.

items.statement: TOPcon line operational by October 2025, taking module capacity to 850 MW
items.quote: The first top -line will be operational by October '25, so that will take Sahaj module manufacturing capacity to 850 megawatts.

items.statement: Expects 60% capacity utilization in first year of new line; >80% of production consumed in-house
items.quote: we are estimating 60% of the production capacity achieved. So in that case, what we are going to sell into the market will be hardly 10 to 15 percentage.

items.statement: Order book of INR304 cr as of 31 March 2025, to be executed in FY26; >80% from government clients
items.quote: As on 31st March 2025, we have a strong order book of INR304 crores comprising of a mixture of government and private sector orders.

items.statement: Participated in bids/negotiations for >INR1,200 cr projects; targets bidding INR2,300 cr in FY26 with 15-20% win rate
items.quote: Yes, we have participated and in process on the negotiation stage for more than INR1,200 crores of projects, whether it's a bidding stage or negotiation stage with the private sales.

items.statement: Expects significant C&I client growth in FY26; active in Maharashtra, MP, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Assam, Tripura for solar water pumping
items.quote: As the company is growing its footprint into the new area, the commercial and industrial clients are also one of the key support systems for the company.

items.statement: Order book composition: 60-65% solar water pumping (Kusum B), 15% Kusum C, 7-8% C&I, 5% off-grid
items.quote: And around 15% is Kusum C, which is like on -grid solar water pumping solution. And rest 60% to 65% is solar water pumping, Kusum B and similar things.

items.statement: FY25 PAT INR28 cr, more than doubled YoY; basic EPS INR27.21 vs INR16.70; declared first interim dividend INR1/share
items.quote: The profit after tax has grew significantly to INR28 crores and more than doubling year -on-year supported by the prudent cost management and higher asset utilization.

items.statement: Developer margin on 4.8 MW Gujarat DREBP project ~10-12% at arm's length; additional EPC margin retained in-house
items.quote: So if you look at arm's length, the margin will be somewhere around 10% to 12% of the margin. But being an in-house EPC, we are going to also get the EPC margin for the company.

items.statement: Receivable days increased due to 40-50% revenue in Q4; ~40-50% of receivables matched by payables to JV partners
items.quote: The number of day has increased , because as I earlier also mentioned that 40% to 50% delay happened in the last quarter.

items.statement: Expects weighted average receivable days to reduce by 15-20 days by H1 FY27 as manufacturing share grows
items.quote: we may see the receivable can come down by a weighted average of 15 to 20 days, but not significantly at least till the first half of 2026-2027.

items.statement: Debt-equity ratio at 0.5% as of FY25
items.quote: The debt-equity ratio stood at a healthy 0.5%.

items.statement: Exploring first projects in Uganda and Zambia; expects execution in FY26; US market exploration planned for 2026-27
items.quote: And in the upcoming financial year, we will see some sort of execution happening in those projects.

items.statement: Beneficiary of first Kusum 2 pilot project in Tripura; PLI scheme not applicable as it requires integrated ingot-to-module manufacturing
items.quote: Not for us because the PLI Scheme is more integrated where the company who starts all the way from inboard manufacturing up to the solar panels, the PLI Scheme is meant for them.

items.statement: Subsidiary Veracity Powertronics adding AC distribution box, compact substation; Veracity Energy does module mounting structures
items.quote: one of the subsidiaries of Sahaj Solar, Veracity Powertronics, has started working on the portfolio of AC distribution box, compact substation

items.statement: Declared first interim dividend of INR1 per share (face value INR10) in FY25
items.quote: Sahaj declared its first interim dividend of INR1 during this journey for each share of INR10.

items.statement: India targeting 500 GW non-fossil fuel by 2030; solar a major beneficiary; repowering opportunity post-2030
items.quote: we have seen the ever-upside target for the solar industry, which is an ambitious target of 500 gigawatts by 2030 of non-fossil fuels.

items.statement: Maharashtra payment protests were for different scheme; Kusum B/Magel Tyala payments coming as expected
items.quote: The protest was for a different thing, not for the Kusum B which we are doing or Magel Tyala Solar Pump Scheme which we are doing.

items.statement: Incorporated two new subsidiaries during FY25; business activity yet to start
items.quote: During the year, we have incorporated two more subsidiaries, but the business activity has yet to start.

items.statement: Awarded Solar EPC Company of the Year (utility-scale <50 MW) and Innovation of the Year (anti-soil nano-coating) at Surya Con 2025
items.quote: the company was recognized with two prestigious awards, Solar EPC Company of the Year, utility-scale, below 50-megawatt capacity, Innovation of the Year for solar panels, anti -soil nano -coating for su perior performance enhancement.

items.statement: Management targets Rs 2,000 crore revenue in FY26, implying at least 20% growth over FY25
items.quote: We are quite confident of reaching our first milestone of being above Rs. 2000 crores during this year.

items.statement: Management sees sustained 20% year-on-year revenue growth as directionally doable over the medium term
items.quote: I t hink this 20% year-on -year is directionally doable with the capability in the market opportunity

items.statement: Order book at start of FY26 stands at Rs 1,624 crore, up 12% from Rs 1,475 crore a year earlier
items.quote: Order booking was strong and this leaves us with an order book as we start the year of Rs. 1,624 crores as compared to Rs. 1,425 crores, Rs. 1,475 crores of the last year.

items.statement: Full-year FY25 order intake was Rs 1,860 crore, up 23% year-on-year and the highest ever
items.quote: The Company recorded new order bookings exceeding Rs. 1,860 crore during FY'25. This is the highest order gaining in the history of the Company.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved to 19% in FY25 from 16.5% in FY24; compression segment margin at 21.7%
items.quote: The year-to-date performance for the year shows an improvement in the EBITDA margin reaching 19% of total income to Rs. 313 crore compared to 16.5% of total income to Rs. 222 crore in the previous year.

items.statement: Management targets EBITDA margin directionally around 20% and compression segment margin around 21-22%, but will trade margin for volume growth
items.quote: Directionally, Company's margin be about 20% EBITDA and the compression segment already 21% plus, we will keep it around 21%, 22%, but we will focus on getting scale in volume.

items.statement: Capex execution in FY25 was near Rs 100 crore; new lost foam casting and semi-hermetic compressor facilities commissioned
items.quote: CAPEX execution for the year was near Rs. 100 crores. The acquisition of the 55.26% stake in S ystems & Components (India) Private Limited during the year allows the Company to scale up its business in the pharma, chemical, and dairy sectors

items.statement: Execution cycle shortened from ~7 months to ~5 months as equipment-to-package mix shifted to 60:40 in favor of equipment
items.quote: We have now actually moved down on an average the execution cycle from about 7 months to about 5 months.

items.statement: Equipment sales now ~60% of mix vs 40% packages, shortening execution cycle and improving working capital
items.quote: Our switch between equipment sales and packet sales has changed 60-40 in a positive direction.

items.statement: Domestic demand strong in food, dairy, pharma, fertilizer, chemicals and general engineering; oil & gas and new energy patchy
items.quote: Domestic market was strong in food, dairy, pharma, fertilizer, and chemicals, and in some sectors of general engineering. Growth in oil and gas sector as well as all the new energy sectors was patchy.

items.statement: Raw material cost as % of sales improved 1.1% YoY in FY25 due to better product mix, order selection, large package execution and export sales
items.quote: However, the YTD percentage of raw material to sales has improved by 1.1% in F Y'25 due to better product mix, better selection of orders, execution of the large packages, and export sales

items.statement: Net working capital reduced to Rs 272 crore (15% of sales) from Rs 300 crore; free cash generation from operations Rs 280 crore
items.quote: The net working capital at Rs. 272 crores as against Rs. 300 crores, a decrease of about Rs. 28 crores over the beginning of the year. This is about 15% of the sale and is in line with our planned objective. Free cash generation from operation was strong at Rs. 280 crores.

items.statement: Company remains debt-free with net cash position of Rs 330 crore+ as of 1 April 2025
items.quote: Company has maintained status as a debt-free Company, and I would like to state that Company still has net cash position of Rs. 330 crore plus as on 1st April 2025.

items.statement: Total dividend for FY25 at 500% (Rs 10 per share), highest ever; includes interim 175% and final 325%
items.quote: In line with our dividend policy, the Board of D irectors have approved a final dividend at the rate of 325% on face value of Rs. 2, that is Rs. 6.50 per share. This is in addition to interim dividend at the rate of 175%, that is Rs. 3.50 per share. So the total dividend for FY '24 is 500%, that is Rs. 10, which is the highest in the history of the Company

items.statement: Acquired 55.26% stake in Systems & Components (India) Pvt Ltd in Dec 2024 to strengthen pharma, chemical, dairy presence
items.quote: The acquisition of the 55.26% stake in S ystems & Components (India) Private Limited during the year allows the Company to scale up its business in the pharma, chemical, and dairy

items.statement: Compressed biogas (CBG) scale-up hindered by unstable biogas generation from variable bio-sources, not compressor technology
items.quote: The big challenge is the generation of stable, significant biogas. So that is why this is not scaling up. If you ask me, will it scale up very quickly? It will go through again the initial 10% story.

items.statement: Tyche semi-hermetic compressor manufacturing facility commissioned at Nashik; lost foam casting (LFC) plant for compressor parts also commissioned
items.quote: Facilities to manufacture the Tyche range of semi-hermetic compressors and the lost foam casting, LFC range of cast iron, SG iron and steel castings for our compressor parts have been commissioned.

items.statement: Employee attrition in single digits, among lowest in industry; IP filings (41 in FY25) and engagement scores reflect strong internal capability building
items.quote: measured by my attrition rate being single digit among the lowest industries of this type. So the engagement and the cap abilities building that has happened is huge

items.statement: All three factories now use solar energy for 30% of total consumption as part of ESG commitment
items.quote: As a commitment to ESG, all our three factories have started using the solar energy to the extent of 30% of the total consumption.

items.statement: Reliance approved Kirloskar as compressor supplier for CBG plants; expects direct equipment orders from Reliance going forward
items.quote: we are an approved supplier of compressors. So there is a move by Reliance. Earlier they were offering the comple te package as an order out to a person who will set up the plant for generating biogas, for compressing it, and to bottle it. Today, they seem to be convinced that the equipment can be directly ordered on reputed

items.statement: Compression segment constitutes ~94% of revenue and sustains profitability in 18-20% range; segment profit 21.7% in FY25
items.quote: With about 94% of the total revenue coming from the compression segment, it remains the only reportable segment. The segment earned profit of about 21.71% in the current year, higher than the previous year when it was 19.8%.

items.statement: Winning ratio on RFQs is 20-40% on average; one large customer can skew conversion
items.quote: But I would like to give you some heads up as a thumb rule, 20% to 40% is a winning ratio we have on an average. Again, one customer, big customer we win, there is going to be even one quote, maybe a 10 million quotes is going to imbalance.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance sustained at 16% +/- 2% for FY26 despite mix changes
items.quote: Last time also, we said 16 plus minus 2. So when you go, we have a little pressure raising the team, adding infrastructure, getting whole set-up going on.

items.statement: US subsidiary capex of Rs 25 crore approved but not needed now; kept for potential M&A or manufacturing if customer demands local presence
items.quote: Over there, those ₹25 CR is just we took an Omni approval. So it's not required right now. Right now, we don't need money there at this point. But we are also looking at, as we had last time question, what is your M&A strategy and so we prepare our self.

items.statement: ~200 employees added in H2 FY25; headcount to rise further in FY26 with second shift
items.quote: H2 as of now was probably around 200. And this year, certainly it's going to rise, it's going to increase. But as of now like, we don't have the exact numbers, but we can keep you posted on that.

items.statement: Corporate tax rate guided at 24% going forward
items.quote: Yes, it will be 24% corporate tax.

items.statement: ~70% of raw materials imported; China share <50% of imports; evaluating PLI and electronic component schemes
items.quote: So if you say as of now, like you can say 70% above, it is getting procured from out of India. 30% is local, like bare PCB and other like specific mechanical parts.

items.statement: Receivables down significantly post March; >50% of March receivables already collected; zero debt
items.quote: So I believe I stated before, like this data is as on 31st March. So whatever receivables were there, we have started receiving the receivables. And significantly of that, like you can say 50% or above has already been received.

items.statement: Current capacity sufficient for Rs 500 crore revenue with minor capex; one SMT line can generate ~Rs 100 crore
items.quote: So current capacity, we are ready for ₹500 crores right now as of today. And we already announced that before previous call also. So our current capacity without maybe minor CapEx, let's see one tools here and there, ₹5 crore, ₹10 crore, but we don't need any more.

items.statement: Revenue target 280+ crore for FY26; aim to sustain 50-70% CAGR
items.quote: So next year like, we are eyeing at as of now 280 plus. Let's keep with that number first. And once we prove on that, definitely, I think we are not going to go anywhere.

items.statement: No immediate equity raise; open to debt for inorganic growth; will consider fund raise after proving 300 crore scale
items.quote: Correct. Ravi Gupta: Okay. Mukesh Vasani: Sneh, you want to add something? I'm okay with that. Sneh Shah: No, I think we are perfectly okay as of now, we cover all overs that are going on EPR ratios and all. And in case if we go anything on inorganic front, then still we have open our debt as an option available. So equity is precious to dilute

items.statement: US/North America contributed 36-37% of H2 FY25 revenue; targeting 70-80% international revenue long-term
items.quote: And coming to your like first question, the contribution of U.S. in second half of the year was somewhere around 36% to 37%, that is including like North America as well as USA.

items.statement: Evaluating PLI and electronic component schemes; decision expected within 1-2 weeks
items.quote: So we are evaluating on three four prospects as of now. One is the PLI that has been recently released by Government of India. This is the second one that you stated. So probably like this evaluation is ongoing and probably before end of this month, we have some fruits on that.

items.statement: China supply disruption risk low; PCB monopoly but alternatives emerging; tariff impact manageable at 4-5% cost pass-through
items.quote: On an average, 4% to 5% extra goes to end user or customers or direct customer like me and you will pay extra, but there is a solution. So it's not like an unsolvable problem.

items.statement: Government targets Rs 500 billion EMS revenue by FY30 per NITI Aayog
items.quote: And by FY 2030, we are eyeing at ₹500 billion in terms of revenue just from the EMS sector. So if we are eyeing at ₹500 billion, then this is a NITI Ayog report, it's not from some specific private source, it's from NITI Aayog itself.

items.statement: Box build share rose from 20% to 27%, end-to-end from 2% to 4%; industrial share fell from 56% to 36% in H2
items.quote: Along with that, our box build share has increased from 20% to 27% and end-to-end from 2% to 4% broadly. So despite our box build segment share gone up, why the margins are lower?

items.statement: US subsidiary created for 3 foreign customers who require local entity; one project worth $10-12M over 2-3 years
items.quote: We are expecting and we already have one of the contract, we said three contract we have, all three foreign contracts. And those are the customer, they do not want to come directly to India and those are the customer we do not want to also go through Aimtron Corporation.

items.statement: Committed to quarterly business updates/press releases; preparing for quarterly results and main board listing
items.quote: we'll do some kind of press release if possible as soon as. Our goal is actually have a quarterly result, because when we go to the main board, we have to do that practice anyway. So hopefully, next year, we have two years most of all the documentations contract with our internal auditor and everybody, it's kind of a six month way
